provenance_policy: Frozen tie contract uses the immutable base bridge field. Derived bridge overlay embeds the same tie uplift; do not rewrite the base hash to create a circular provenance.

proof.method: Intersect exact apron with tie domains already split at every bridge profile breakplane. On each convex piece the bridge height is linear, tie height is max(2.2, that field), so all vertices at2.2 prove all interior points at2.2.

ownership_rule.rising_tie_outside_shared_regions: Retain exact terrain r04 height field and bridge junction uplift.
